ocp_records.title: graphite · chen-2020 · analytical formula

temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Electrode lithium fraction c_s/c_s,max as defined by the upstream implementation; not whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Mathematical stoichiometry interval; an experimentally validated fitting interval is not established here.

cell_link.evidence: Upstream function docstring identifies LG M50; exact specimen and batch are not established.

processing.changes: Renamed sto to x; removed numpy namespace. Coefficients unchanged.

limitations: No raw experimental points are claimed for this expression.
No separate lithiation/delithiation branch or temperature law is supplied.
Not a complete or independently validated cell parameter set.
Effective commercial negative-electrode formula; do not interpret as a universal pure-graphite material law.

ocp_records.title: NMC811 | nmc_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 | implementation expression

temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Electrode lithium fraction c_s/c_s,max in the upstream function; not whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Mathematical 0..1 evaluation interval. Fit validity and usable operating stoichiometry limits have not been independently established; endpoint voltages may be outside cell operating limits.

cell_link.evidence: Same LG M50 model and Chen2020 study as the existing negative OCP and three full-cell test files. Identical characterization/validation specimen not established.

processing.changes: AST-checked local-variable substitution; sto renamed to x. Numeric constants and mathematical operations retained. No upstream function is executed by the importer.

limitations: An implementation expression, not original measured points or a newly fitted curve.
The mathematical domain is not an experimentally verified validity range; do not use endpoint values as operating cutoffs.
No separate lithiation/delithiation branch is supplied; no independent full-cell model validation is claimed.
Same LG M50 model and Chen2020 study as the existing negative OCP and three full-cell test files. Identical characterization/validation specimen not established.
